all_required_checks.coverage_support: known-training coverage has nonzero bins in every scenario
all_required_checks.known_f1_nonregression: absolute NAC-UE-Fixed minus source-energy Known F1 <= 1e-12 in every scenario
all_required_checks.metric_breadth: NAC-UE-Fixed has positive mean oriented gain over Energy on at least 2 of 4 metrics
all_required_checks.nondegenerate_score: validation and test NAC confidence standard deviations exceed 1e-12 in every scenario
all_required_checks.overall_gain: mean of four NAC-UE-Fixed-versus-Energy oriented mean gains is strictly positive
all_required_checks.split_integrity: NAC-UE-Fixed, source MLP and OpenDetect split fingerprints identical
all_required_checks.suite_robustness: at least 4 of 7 suites have nonnegative four-metric mean gain and worst suite >= -0.05
all_required_checks.top_two_rank: NAC-UE-Fixed four-unknown-metric mean rank among three pilot methods <= 2.0

failure_action: retain the 14-scenario pilot and do not spend the full-matrix budget
full_matrix_action: run all 102 frozen seed7 scenarios only if every required check passes
oriented_metric_rule: higher is better except lower unknown_fpr95 is better
